name: english-quest-monorepo
description: English Quest — Gamified AI-ready English learning platform (CEFR A1-C2 & IELTS)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck --workspace=@english-quest/shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@english-quest/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@english-quest/shared && npm run test --workspace=frontend && npm run test --workspace=backend
